title: Dallas Scavenger Hunt by Wacky Walks
blurb: You'll use an app to explore Dallas in this fun scavenger hunt. Use the app to find things around the city, take photos and collect points. At the end, take a look at the rankings to see your score compared to other teams across the country. All our Scavenger hunts have a live remote host to help along the way. Come out and explore with us in Dallas.
